{"items": [
{"type": "reference", "text": "Policy DEC - Vendor Relations", "cited_instrument": "Policy DEC"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Policy DCA - Gifts, Bequests, Donations, and Solicitations", "cited_instrument": "Policy DCA"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Policy DJ - Grants, Mini-Grants, and Special Projects", "cited_instrument": "Policy DJ"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Account Credentials", "text": "Account Credentials - any information used specifically to gain access to a technology or system."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Least Privilege", "text": "Least Privilege - only those privileges that are required for a user to fulfill the user's responsibilities."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Peripheral", "text": "Peripheral - a device or unit that operates separately from a computer, laptop, tablet, or server but is connected to it either physically or logically."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Sensitive Data", "text": "Sensitive Data - electronically stored or transmitted information that contains elements that may be considered personally identifiable information (PII), including full name, social security number, driver's license number, home or work address, birthday, credit card number, or any information that may harm AACPS and its stakeholders, if disclosed."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Telecommunications", "text": "Telecommunications - the entire technological infrastructure that handles voice, video, and data traffic that either begins, ends, or continues within AACPS property."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Technology", "text": "Technology - hardware or software, including computers, laptops, servers, tablets, switches, routers, firewalls, wireless devices, telephones, cellular phones, audio equipment, video equipment, software systems, online resources, and email."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "User or Users", "text": "User or Users - AACPS employees, students, parents/guardians, organizations, or approved third parties accessing or utilizing school system technology or telecommunication services."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "commercial purposes", "text": "For commercial purposes, defined as offering or providing goods or services for personal use;"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The purchase of technology shall be in accordance with Policy DEC - Vendor Relations.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "Policy DEC - Vendor Relations"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Technology donations shall be in accordance with Policy DCA - Gifts, Bequests, Donations, and Solicitations.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "Policy DCA - Gifts, Bequests, Donations, and Solicitations"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Technology grants shall be in accordance with Policy DJ - Grants, Mini-Grants, and Special Projects.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "Policy DJ - Grants, Mini-Grants, and Special Projects"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may only use AACPS technology: i. In a civil, ethical, legal, and responsible manner in accordance with AACPS policies, regulations, and State law.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may only use AACPS technology: ii. To communicate with their elected representatives only for AACPS educational purposes.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: i. For commercial purposes, defined as offering or providing goods or services for personal use;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: ii. For personal lobbying or other personal political activities;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: iii. To gain or attempt to gain unauthorized access to any technology or data. This is strictly prohibited and constitutes a violation of this regulation and its accompanying policy;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "constitutes a violation of this regulation and its accompanying policy"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: iv. To knowingly deploy malware or other software with malicious intent;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: v. To eavesdrop on AACPS telecommunications or related services;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: vi. To access AACPS-provided technology via another individual user's account credentials, except in emergencies.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "After emergency access has been granted, the account credentials that were used shall be changed as soon as possible;", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "as soon as possible"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: vii. To attempt to circumvent, modify, or disable technology security protection measures implemented by AACPS, including:", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: viii. To engage or participate in any illegal act such as arranging for the purchase of drugs, alcohol, or other controlled substances, engaging in criminal activity, threatening the safety of any person, or participating in any activity that may be improper, illegal, unethical, or inappropriate;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: ix. To access, write, store, or publish material that is profane or obscene, that advocates illegal acts, or that advocates violence or discrimination towards other people;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: x. To communicate obscene, profane, lewd, vulgar, rude, inflammatory, threatening, or disrespectful language, pictures, or gestures;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: xi. To engage in personal attacks, including the writing or posting of any defamatory, prejudicial, or discriminatory media;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: xii. To make statements that are libelous, defamatory, slanderous, or that harass another person;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: xiii. To copy or transfer copyrighted materials and software without proper authorization;", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "without proper authorization"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: xiv. To store or execute games or personal software applications without prior approval from the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee; or", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "prior approval from the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not use AACPS technology: xv. To stream audio or video from the Internet for unauthorized personal use such as listening to Internet radio stations or streaming video.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users shall: i. Promptly disclose to appropriate school system personnel any communication or materials that are or may be inappropriate or that makes them feel uncomfortable;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "Promptly disclose to appropriate school system personnel"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users shall: ii. Comply with requests from appropriate school system employees to cease activities that threaten the operation or integrity of any AACPS technology component;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null}
]}

{"items":[{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS reserves the right to take any and all necessary actions to protect the availability, confidentiality, and integrity of its technology and related data.","force":"permission","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS reserves the right to take any and all necessary actions to prevent its technology from being used to attack, damage, harm, or exploit others.","force":"permission","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Electronic communication of sensitive data shall be encrypted to ensure the confidentiality of the data being transmitted.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Users shall ensure that websites to which they are transmitting sensitive data contain the URL header of https:// rather than http:// to ensure the confidentiality of the data being transmitted.","force":"obligation","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Users may not use AACPS electronic communications systems for personal, commercial, profitable, religious, or political use.","force":"prohibition","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Users may not use AACPS electronic communications systems to transmit messages, images, cartoons, epithets, or slurs based upon actual or perceived race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, disability, or homeless status.","force":"prohibition","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS systems that store or transmit sensitive employee data, student record data, financial data, or other legally confidential data shall implement appropriate authentication technologies to prevent unauthorized access or modification.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS systems that store or transmit sensitive employee data, student record data, financial data, or other legally confidential data","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Users of AACPS electronic communications systems shall ensure that both their usage and electronic communications content are in compliance with all other AACPS policies and regulations and applicable negotiated agreements.","force":"obligation","binds":"Users of AACPS electronic communications systems","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Users may not post or send via email chain letters or other unsolicited messages, also known as sending spam.","force":"prohibition","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Spam distribution using AACPS technology is strictly prohibited.","force":"prohibition","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Broadcast emails, or messages to a large number of individuals or groups through the network, shall be administrative, educational, or instructionally related.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Users may not transmit user account credentials to other parties using non-secure communications, including email and interoffice mail.","force":"prohibition","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall conduct email communications regarding AACPS matters on AACPS-approved email systems.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Physical access to data centers, main distribution frames, and intermediate distribution frames shall be controlled to restrict, prevent, and detect unauthorized access to these areas.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Access to these areas shall only be provided to individuals who have legitimate responsibilities for these areas and the contents contained in these areas.","force":"prohibition","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Data centers shall be secured using technologies that monitor individual access and provide non-reputable access logs for investigative purposes.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Individuals and users shall take reasonable steps to ensure the physical security of AACPS technology and data.","force":"obligation","binds":"Individuals and users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Users shall log out, lock, or shutdown computers when unattended.","force":"obligation","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"Exceptions shall be made for computer labs and public access computers and kiosks.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS may employ technologies that log out, lock, or shutdown computers after pre-defined periods of inactivity.","force":"permission","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null}]}

{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS applications and systems shall be developed or procured in compliance with all local, State, and federal laws and regulations.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "When administratively appropriate, all AACPS applications shall employ the latest software versions and patch levels to ensure maximum functionality and security.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "all AACPS applications", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS training system data may not include confidential information.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS application and source code shall be managed in a secure, controlled, and auditable environment.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Software and systems shall comply with applicable vendor licensing and fair use agreements.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Software and systems", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users shall abide by the vendor Terms of Service and privacy policy.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Software and systems that do not publish Terms of Service and a privacy policy may not be used for AACPS-sanctioned activities.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Free and open-source software shall be approved prior to use by the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "approved prior to use by the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee is authorized to monitor AACPS technology for potential misuse and security violations.", "force": "permission", "binds": "The Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The Chief Information Officer or Chief Information Officer's designee shall coordinate annual technology security vulnerability assessments and penetration tests in accordance with current industry best practices.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The Chief Information Officer or Chief Information Officer's designee", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "annual"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS may contract with third party individuals or organizations to perform vulnerability assessments and penetration tests.", "force": "permission", "binds": "AACPS", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS may employ encryption technologies for hard drives, flash drives, databases, and other storage media, as necessary, to further secure sensitive AACPS technology-related data.", "force": "permission", "binds": "AACPS", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Investigations that lead to search and seizures on school property involving technology shall be in accordance with State law and regulations and Regulation JCC-RAJ - Search and Seizure.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Investigations that lead to search and seizures on school property involving technology", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Regulation JCC-RAJ - Search and Seizure", "cited_instrument": "Regulation JCC-RAJ"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "In accordance with the Children's Internet Protection Act, AACPS shall deploy technologies which attempt to filter abusive, libelous, obscene, offensive, pornographic, illegal, or otherwise inappropriate material.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "AACPS", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Children's Internet Protection Act", "cited_instrument": "Children's Internet Protection Act"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS-sponsored online systems shall comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "AACPS-sponsored online systems", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Children's Online Privacy Protection Act", "cited_instrument": "Children's Online Privacy Protection Act"}
]}

{"items":[
{"type":"obligation","text":"Passwords may not be the same as the user ID.","force":"prohibition","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Passwords may not be shared with others.","force":"prohibition","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Passwords shall be a minimum of eight characters and shall meet at least three of the following four requirements:","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Special character, which is highly desirable.","force":"recommendation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Password changes shall be required at various intervals, depending on the capabilities of the system.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"depending on the capabilities of the system"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Password reuse is strongly discouraged.","force":"recommendation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"System and directory service passwords shall expire at a minimum of every 45 days and at a maximum of every 180 days, depending on the capabilities of the system.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"at a minimum of every 45 days and at a maximum of every 180 days"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Employee user accounts shall be disabled for 60 minutes after five consecutive unsuccessful login attempts.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"after five consecutive unsuccessful login attempts"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"For systems that cannot meet this requirement, the most stringent capability shall apply.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Employee user accounts shall expire after 90 days of inactivity unless otherwise directed by the Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"unless otherwise directed by the Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS reserves the right to modify employee account credentials for individuals upon change in employment status and directed by the Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee.","force":"permission","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"upon change in employment status and directed by the Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Employees who separate from employment shall have their accounts disabled as soon as practically possible.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"as soon as practically possible"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Shared user accounts are permitted only when they are required to provide specific access or functionality or when multi-user access is not available.","force":"prohibition","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Password changes shall be required as needed.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS reserves the right to disable student accounts.","force":"permission","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Students who leave AACPS shall have their accounts disabled.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Student user accounts shall be disabled for 60 minutes after five consecutive unsuccessful login attempts.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"after five consecutive unsuccessful login attempts"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"For systems that cannot meet this requirement, the most stringent capability will apply.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Student user accounts shall expire after 180 days of inactivity unless otherwise directed by the Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"unless otherwise directed by the Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Access to AACPS storage media, including magnetic tapes, internal and external hard drives, CDs, DVDs, and flash drives shall be secured using least privilege methodology.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"using least privilege methodology"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"When applicable, encryption technologies shall be used to protect sensitive data.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS storage media, including magnetic tapes, internal and external hard drives, CDs, DVDs, and flash drives shall be disposed of in accordance with the current National Institute of Standards and Technology publications.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"in accordance with the current National Institute of Standards and Technology publications"},
{"type":"reference","text":"National Institute of Standards and Technology publications","cited_instrument":"NIST publications"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Users may not connect non-AACPS owned technology to any AACPS network, whether wired or wirelessly, without prior written approval by the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee.","force":"prohibition","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"prior written approval by the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"No person may install wiring, wireless connections, or any extension or retransmission of network services without the express written approval of the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee.","force":"prohibition","binds":"No person","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"the express written approval of the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Users may not scan the network to examine or determine security or monitoring measures.","force":"prohibition","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Users shall follow guidelines concerning use of telecommunication connections, networks, and applications as established by the Office of Information Technology and published in the AACPS Employee Handbook, AACPS Student Handbook , Board policies, and AACPS regulations.","force":"obligation","binds":"Users","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"reference","text":"AACPS Employee Handbook","cited_instrument":"AACPS Employee Handbook"},
{"type":"reference","text":"AACPS Student Handbook","cited_instrument":"AACPS Student Handbook"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Wireless access points shall be configured utilizing Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 (WPA2) or greater encryption for transmissions, unless an exception has been expressly approved by the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"unless an exception has been expressly approved by the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 (WPA2)","cited_instrument":"WPA2"}
]}

{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Alert the school principal or principal's designee and the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee if they are aware of suspicious or inappropriate use of AACPS technology, including abuse and possible breaches of security", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Take reasonable precautions to protect AACPS-issued technology and related data against damage, theft, loss, or disclosure", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Be financially responsible for costs incurred due to an individual's negligence or misuse that result in the destruction, loss, or theft of AACPS technology.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not damage, destroy, or tamper with the integrity of electronic information, data, or content.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users may not make unauthorized copies or reproductions of AACPS information or data.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Employees may, on a limited and infrequent basis only, use AACPS technology for personal use.", "force": "permission", "binds": "Employees", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Except in emergency situations, employees shall limit personal use of AACPS technology to lunch breaks and scheduled work breaks only.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "employees", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Such usage may not affect an employee's productivity and if it does, it shall cease immediately.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "it shall cease immediately"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An employee's supervisor is authorized to determine whether such usage is affecting the employee's productivity.", "force": "permission", "binds": "An employee's supervisor", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "In such cases, besides disciplinary action, the employee's personal use may be suspended or revoked.", "force": "permission", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "disciplinary action"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Employees shall avoid using AACPS technology for personal use during otherwise productive business hours.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Employees", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "In addition to the other conditions described in this regulation, employees are specifically prohibited from using AACPS technology to operate a business, conduct an external job search, solicit money for personal gain, campaign for political causes or candidates, participate in organized labor activities or union business, except as permitted under State or federal laws or the applicable Negotiated Agreement, or promote or solicit funds for a religious or other personal cause.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "employees", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "During periods of anticipated high or mission critical activity, AACPS may restrict or prohibit personal use in order to preserve resources for business use.", "force": "permission", "binds": "AACPS", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS technology users shall comply with all applicable federal, State, and local laws and regulations, including:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "AACPS technology users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "The Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act", "cited_instrument": "Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "The Children's Online Privacy Protection Act", "cited_instrument": "Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "The Protection of Pupil Rights Amendment", "cited_instrument": "Protection of Pupil Rights Amendment (PPRA)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "The Maryland Student Privacy Act of 2015", "cited_instrument": "Maryland Student Privacy Act of 2015"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS technology users shall have no expectation of privacy in the contents of their electronic files on any AACPS-provided systems and storage devices.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "AACPS technology users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Users shall password protect electronic files containing sensitive information.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Users", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS reserves the right to access or disclose, for investigative purposes, the contents of electronic communications, files, and other materials created, stored, or accessed using AACPS technology.", "force": "permission", "binds": "AACPS", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS reserves the right to archive, audit, or purge the contents of electronic communications, files, and other materials created, stored, or accessed using AACPS technology.", "force": "permission", "binds": "AACPS", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If this occurs, an investigation into the violation may be conducted.", "force": "permission", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An individual search of technology and related data shall be conducted if determined necessary or appropriate by the Division of Investigations, the Chief Information Officer, or the Division of Safe and Orderly Schools.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "if determined necessary or appropriate by the Division of Investigations, the Chief Information Officer, or the Division of Safe and Orderly Schools"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Public Information Act", "cited_instrument": "Public Information Act"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Employees may not disclose student data, employee data, or other AACPS-owned data to any third party unless directed to do so by their immediate supervisor or administrator.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Employees", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "unless directed to do so by their immediate supervisor or administrator"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Vendor contracts shall include appropriate non-disclosure agreements for the protection of AACPS data and their stakeholders.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS electronic data shall be physically stored within the United States to ensure that all United States data privacy and protection laws and regulations are applicable.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Exceptions may be made only with prior approval from the Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "prior approval from the Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee"}
]}
